notes.title: El Matador is featured in Czech & Slovak Games Week!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

El Matador will be a part of this year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41475492/sale/CZSKGamesWeek2022][b]Czech & Slovak Games Week[/b][/url]! The event, including a stream with many new announcements and updates about various Czech and Slovak games, starts at [b]7PM CET today, November 14[/b] and you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41475492/sale/CZSKGamesWeek2022][b]watch it here[/b][/url].

Multiple games published by Fulqrum Publishing are featured at the event, one of them being the freshly released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287530/Lords_and_Villeins/][b]Lords and Villeins[/b][/url]! The developer of the game will be streaming live gameplay at 9PM CET and you can watch it either on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41475492/sale/CZSKGamesWeek2022]event page[/url] or the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287530/Lords_and_Villeins/]Steam store page[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287530/Lords_and_Villeins/

notes.title: El Matador is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and El Matador is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!
